## Physical intent

Describe the physical problem and the smallest geometry change that addresses it.

## Preserved constraints

- [ ] PCB positions and dimensions are unchanged, or changes are documented.
- [ ] Screw-hole positions are unchanged, or changes are documented.
- [ ] Proven panel angles are unchanged.
- [ ] Electrical connector corners remain clear.
- [ ] Centre-panel geometry remains inside the pentagon boundary.
- [ ] Outside faces remain printable flat on the bed.

## Verification

- [ ] Manifold STL compiled, or not applicable.
- [ ] Assembly/PCB preview inspected where available.
- [ ] Generated STL inspected.
- [ ] Physical print tested, or marked as not yet tested.
